description: A3 task 10b (F8 part 2; #744): Overview facts, required equipment and equipment assets on Round 7’s owners. /review’s Overview hands its facts with their FactKind (src/state/review.ts) to Round 7’s SummaryFacts (src/ui/composition.tsx), which orders, glyphs and sets the term visibility of each by its kind, not its word (TASK-AC-010B47E192B5); /history/:id’s Overview hands the record’s own facts to the same composition and gains Round 7’s EquipmentSummary built from the saved equipment_used, each item once, bodyweight excluded, None — bodyweight only only when true (TASK-AC-BF12C17FC7BF); the gallery’s per-exercise equipment stays. check-01 runs src/ui/summary-facts.test.tsx, which this task owns whole (TASK-004’s ten carried cases, TASK-AC-A82C56A627E7); TASK-029’s carried block in src/ui/movement-identity.test.tsx is TASK-029 check-01 (anchored name filter). parity compares /review, /history/:id, /summary, /onboarding’s Setup equipment and /workout with the accepted overview and assets states at 320 and 390 (TASK-AC-49761FC1B153). Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-118 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/summary-facts.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
